have h : ∀ (A : Set ℝ²) (ε : ℝ), ε > 0 → A.Infinite → NonTrilinearFor A ε → ¬ WeaklyNonTrilinear A := by
    intro A ε hε hAinf Hnt
    by_contra hW
    obtain ⟨B, hWeq, hBelem⟩ := hW
    have hBfin : B.Finite := Finset.finite_toSet B
    have hempty : B = ∅ := by
      have h1 : ↑B = A := by simpa using hWeq
      have h2 : (↑B : Set ℝ²).Finite := hBfin
      have h3 : A.Finite := by simpa using h2
      exact (Finset.card_eq_zero_of_forall_not_mem (by intro b hb; exact hBelem b hb)).symm
    have h4 : (∅ : Finset (Set ℝ²)).sSup = ∅ := by simp
    have h5 : A = ∅ := by simpa [h4, hempty] using hWeq
    have h6 : ¬ A.Infinite := by simpa [h5] using (Set.not_infinite_of_finite (Set.finite_empty))
    exact h6 hAinf
  intro h
  have hA : Set.univ.Infinite := by simpa using (Set.infinite_univ : Set.univ.Infinite)
  have hnt : NonTrilinearFor (Set.univ : Set ℝ²) 1 := by
    intro B hB
    exact ⟨B, ⟨le_rfl, NonTrilinear.univ⟩⟩
  have h := h (Set.univ : Set ℝ²) 1 (by norm_num) hA hnt
  exact h
